dataset: Open share offers in Kenya, for the IPO helper
note: Every term is copied from our published Receipt for the offer, which cites the offer documents. When a Receipt is corrected, this file is corrected with it (tests/site/test_ipo_calc.py checks the two agree).

offers.name: Quickmart
offers.costs_note: The KES 575.6 million in offer costs is paid by the seller. If buyers take less than 75% of the shares, the offer lapses and everyone is refunded without interest.

offers.name: Dangote refinery (Kenya receipts)
offers.min_note: Cut from 2,000 to 10 receipts, as reported by Business Today; we have not yet seen the amended memorandum.
offers.trading_note: on the NSE, expected in December
offers.dividend_note: The prospectus sets no dividend payout. Any dividend is taxed 10% in Nigeria and 5% in Kenya.
offers.costs_note: The memorandum puts the Kenyan offer's costs at about 1.8% of the target, paid by holders, plus a custody fee of 0.16% a year. A receipt's value moves with the naira against the shilling as well as with the refinery.
